verses.text: I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.
lines: I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart.
I will tell of all your marvelous works.

verses.text: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
lines: I will be glad and rejoice in you.
I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.

verses.text: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.
lines: When my enemies turn back,
they stumble and perish in your presence.

verses.text: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.
lines: For you have maintained my just cause.
You sit on the throne judging righteously.

verses.text: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.
lines: You have rebuked the nations.
You have destroyed the wicked.
You have blotted out their name forever and ever.

verses.text: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.
lines: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin.
The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.

verses.text: But Yahweh reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.
lines: But Yahweh reigns forever.
He has prepared his throne for judgment.

verses.text: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.
lines: He will judge the world in righteousness.
He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

verses.text: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.
lines: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed;
a high tower in times of trouble.

verses.text: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.
lines: Those who know your name will put their trust in you,
for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.

verses.text: Sing praises to Yahweh, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.
lines: Sing praises to Yahweh, who dwells in Zion,
and declare among the people what he has done.

verses.text: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.
lines: For he who avenges blood remembers them.
He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.

verses.text: Have mercy on me, Yahweh. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,
lines: Have mercy on me, Yahweh.
See my affliction by those who hate me,
and lift me up from the gates of death,

verses.text: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
lines: that I may show all of your praise.
I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.

verses.text: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.
lines: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made.
In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.

verses.text: Yahweh has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands.
lines: Yahweh has made himself known.
He has executed judgment.
The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands.

verses.text: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.
lines: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol,
even all the nations that forget God.

verses.text: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.
lines: For the needy shall not always be forgotten,
nor the hope of the poor perish forever.

verses.text: Arise, Yahweh! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.
lines: Arise, Yahweh! Don’t let man prevail.
Let the nations be judged in your sight.

verses.text: Put them in fear, Yahweh. Let the nations know that they are only men.
lines: Put them in fear, Yahweh.
Let the nations know that they are only men.
